sources.verifiedBy: read from the stored copy in watcher/state/snapshots/la-706e332554.txt.gz: Who Must File, Payment Frequency, File and Pay Electronically, Annual Reconciliation. The page states the payment-frequency thresholds but no payment due dates; the rate tables (R-1306) and the emergency rule on tables do not state them either.

efile.text: Every employer who withholds, or is required to withhold, Louisiana income tax must file a quarterly withholding tax return electronically for every assigned filing period. Payments must be submitted electronically according to your assigned payment frequency.

returns.name: Form L-3, Annual Withholding Reconciliation
contents: Filed electronically (LaWage may be used) by January 31 after the year, or 30 days after final wages if the business closes.
The quarterly return is Form L-1; it is required even for zero returns, with the month-by-month amounts and payments for the quarter.

notModelled: Louisiana's payment frequency is assigned from the average monthly withholding: quarterly under $500, monthly $500 to under $5,000, semi-monthly $5,000 or more. The page does NOT state the due dates for any frequency (or the Form L-1 due date), so no deposit schedule is computed.
